query:
UPDATE crm_contacts ct
            SET hidden = $3
            WHERE ct.team_id = $1
              AND (
                  (ct.company_id IS NULL AND split_part(LOWER(ct.email), '@', 2) = $2)
                  OR ct.company_id IN (
                      SELECT d.company_id FROM crm_domains d
                      WHERE d.team_id = $1 AND LOWER(d.domain) = $2
                  )
              )
